cards.claim: Nõmme Kalju FC plays in the Meistriliiga league.
cards.quote: Nõmme Kalju FC, founded in 1923, has been a stalwart of Estonian football, and its journey is intricately woven into the fabric of the country's top division, the Meistriliiga. As we delve into the world of Estonian football, we find ourselves in the midst of a league that has been the pinnacle of competition since its inception in 1992. The Meistriliiga, which translates to "Championship League" in English, has been the benchmark of excellence for Estonian clubs, and Nõmme Kalju FC has been an integral part of this journey. The evidence of Nõmme Kalju FC's participation in the Meistriliiga league is multifaceted and far-reaching.
